knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Hot embers can melt a plastic liner or start a fire in the waste. Odour is secondary.
Filler that scooping no longer clears is replaced. Masking odour or scooping harder does not fix it.
Eye protection and gloves are the baseline for ash and debris handling.
The heat is the first hazard section says to treat every ashtray as hot until it has been checked.

practicalCriteria: Checks an ashtray for embers and treats it as hot until checked, before any bagging.
Empties a sand-filled urn in several passes and seals the debris in a bag once cool.
Replaces filler that scooping no longer clears, and refills it to just below the rim, level.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of an ashtray empty and clean
stopWorkCriteria: Hot ash placed in a plastic liner or general waste
Ash handled without gloves or safety glasses
